title: Chapelizod
html_source: Chapelizod (Irish: Séipéal Iosóid, meaning “Iseult’s Chapel”) is a village preserved within the city of Dublin, Ireland. It lies in the wooded valley of the River Liffey, near the Strawberry Beds and the Phoenix Park.
